# Intuit
> Financial technology platform powering consumers, small businesses, and professionals with tax, accounting, credit, and marketing tools.

Intuit’s ecosystem includes TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, Mailchimp, and professional tax and accounting solutions. The site spans product information, developer platforms, support resources, blogs, and tools for accountants, small businesses, and consumers.

## Main Platform
- [Intuit Home](https://www.intuit.com/): Corporate homepage for Intuit’s consumer, business, and professional financial software products.
- [Products Overview](https://www.intuit.com/products/): Overview of Intuit’s major products including TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp.
- [Company](https://www.intuit.com/company/): Corporate information, leadership, mission, and company background.
- [Careers](https://www.intuit.com/careers/): Jobs, culture, benefits, and opportunities across Intuit teams.
- [Blog](https://www.intuit.com/blog/): Company news, insights, innovation updates, and financial topics from Intuit.
- [Investors](https://investors.intuit.com/): Investor relations, earnings, SEC filings, events, and financial information.

## TurboTax
- [TurboTax Home](https://turbotax.intuit.com/): Online tax filing product for individuals with DIY and expert-assisted options.
- [TurboTax Support](https://ttlc.intuit.com/): Help center and community support for TurboTax products and tax filing questions.
- [TurboTax Blog](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/): Tax tips, filing guidance, deductions, credits, and refund-related articles.
- [TurboTax Login](https://myturbotax.intuit.com/): Sign-in portal for accessing TurboTax accounts and tax returns.
- [TurboTax Free Edition](https://turbotax.intuit.com/personal-taxes/online/free-edition.jsp): Free online filing option for simple tax returns.
- [TurboTax Live](https://turbotax.intuit.com/personal-taxes/online/live/): Tax filing with access to live expert help and review services.

## QuickBooks
- [QuickBooks Home](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/): Small business accounting platform for bookkeeping, invoicing, payroll, and payments.
- [QuickBooks Blog](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/blog/): Articles on accounting, cash flow, payroll, taxes, and running a business.
- [QuickBooks Support](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/learn-support/): Product help, troubleshooting, and learning resources for QuickBooks users.
- [QuickBooks Online](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/online/): Cloud accounting software for small businesses and self-employed users.
- [QuickBooks Payroll](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/payroll/): Payroll software for paying employees, filing taxes, and managing compliance.
- [QuickBooks Payments](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/payments/): Payment processing tools for invoices, cards, and online transactions.
- [QuickBooks Time](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/time-tracking/): Time tracking and scheduling tools for teams and field workers.

## Credit Karma
- [Credit Karma Home](https://www.creditkarma.com/): Personal finance platform for credit scores, monitoring, and financial recommendations.
- [Credit Karma Tax Information](https://www.creditkarma.com/tax): Tax-related information and product guidance within Credit Karma.
- [Credit Karma Resources](https://www.creditkarma.com/advice): Educational articles on credit, debt, loans, and personal finance.
- [Credit Karma Help Center](https://support.creditkarma.com/): Support resources for account, credit monitoring, and product issues.

## Mailchimp
- [Mailchimp Home](https://mailchimp.com/): Marketing automation and email platform for businesses and creators.
- [Mailchimp Marketing Library](https://mailchimp.com/resources/): Guides, templates, and educational resources for marketing and customer engagement.
- [Mailchimp Help Center](https://mailchimp.com/help/): Product documentation and support for campaigns, audiences, and automations.
- [Mailchimp Developers](https://mailchimp.com/developer/): Developer documentation for APIs, integrations, and app extensions.
- [Mailchimp Content Studio](https://mailchimp.com/features/content-studio/): Asset management tools for organizing and reusing marketing content.
- [Mailchimp Integrations](https://mailchimp.com/integrations/): Directory of integrations connecting Mailchimp with ecommerce and business tools.

## Professional Tax & Accounting
- [Intuit Accountants](https://www.intuit.com/accountants/): Professional solutions for accountants, bookkeepers, and tax preparers.
- [Tax Pro Center](https://accountants.intuit.com/taxprocenter/): News, insights, and resources for tax professionals using Intuit products.
- [ProConnect Tax Online](https://accountants.intuit.com/tax-online/): Cloud-based professional tax preparation software for firms and preparers.
- [Lacerte](https://accountants.intuit.com/tax/lacerte/): Professional tax software for complex returns and established tax practices.
- [ProSeries](https://accountants.intuit.com/tax/proseries/): Tax preparation software for professional preparers and accounting firms.
- [QuickBooks for Accountants](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/accountants/): Tools and resources for accountants supporting QuickBooks clients.
- [Accountants Community](https://accountants.intuit.com/community/): Community discussions, product help, and peer support for accounting professionals.

## Developer Platform
- [Intuit Developer](https://developer.intuit.com/): Developer hub for building apps and integrations with Intuit platforms.
- [QuickBooks API Docs](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/get-started): Getting started documentation for QuickBooks Online APIs.
- [QuickBooks Online API Reference](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/api/accounting/all-entities/account): API reference for QuickBooks accounting entities and operations.
- [OAuth 2.0 Guide](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/authentication-and-authorization/oauth-2.0): Authentication and authorization guide for Intuit platform integrations.
- [Webhooks Docs](https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/develop/webhooks): Webhooks documentation for receiving QuickBooks event notifications.
- [App Marketplace](https://apps.com/): Marketplace for apps and integrations that connect with QuickBooks.

## Support & Learning
- [Intuit Support](https://www.intuit.com/support/): Central support entry point across Intuit consumer and business products.
- [QuickBooks Learn and Support](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/learn-support/): Help articles, tutorials, and troubleshooting for QuickBooks products.
- [TurboTax Community](https://ttlc.intuit.com/community): Community forum for tax questions, product help, and filing guidance.
- [Mailchimp Help](https://mailchimp.com/help/): Searchable support documentation for Mailchimp features and workflows.
- [Credit Karma Support](https://support.creditkarma.com/): Help center for account access, disputes, and monitoring issues.

## Small Business & Education Resources
- [QuickBooks Resource Center](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/): Small business articles, calculators, and operational guidance.
- [Intuit for Education](https://www.intuit.com/solutions/education/): Financial literacy and education initiatives supported by Intuit.
- [QuickBooks Small Business Blog](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/blog/): Practical guidance for entrepreneurs on finance, operations, and growth.
- [Mailchimp Resources](https://mailchimp.com/resources/): Marketing education for email, automation, ecommerce, and customer retention.
- [TurboTax Tax Tips](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/): Consumer tax education covering filing rules, deductions, and credits.

## Canada
- [Intuit Canada](https://www.intuit.com/ca/): Canadian homepage for Intuit products and regional offerings.
- [QuickBooks Canada](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/): Canadian QuickBooks site for accounting, invoicing, and payroll solutions.
- [TurboTax Canada](https://turbotax.intuit.ca/): Canadian tax filing software and resources for personal tax returns.
- [Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/): Marketing platform available to Canadian businesses and organizations.
- [Credit Karma Canada](https://www.creditkarma.ca/): Canadian personal finance platform for credit scores and financial tools.
